about:
Southern Electrical Equipment Company (SEECO) was founded in 1920 in Monroe, North Carolina, when a group of engineers left Duke Power to establish a company dedicated to designing better products for the electrical utility industry.

The company manufactures low-, medium-, and high-voltage group-operated disconnect switches for transmission and substation applications, with ratings from 15 kV to 500 kV and 600 A to 4,000 A. Its product line also includes interrupting devices, motor operators, ground switches, auxiliary switches, and automation and control systems that integrate with existing supervisory control platforms. Designs follow IEEE standards, and the firm emphasizes tailored solutions for specific customer requirements.

SEECO serves the electrical utility sector, supplying equipment for transmission and substation projects. Its switches and complementary devices are used in sectionalizing and switching applications across utility networks.

The company cites its engineer-driven culture and ISO 9001:2015 certification as foundations for reliability and performance. Notable innovations include unitized transmission switches, line-post sensors for automation, vacuum interrupters, and the Smart Universal Motor Operator (SUMO), a universal motor with torsional or reciprocating capabilities. Its mission emphasizes intelligently engineered solutions for greater performance, reliability, and ease of installation, backed by exceptional service and support.
